name: q1-relay-lab
description: the hand-wired relay sheet (150 cells, no mutation or turnover), the signals view; a touch of the signal pipette at its left edge at 8 s; pictures every 1-2 s as the wave goes

evals.js: const f = await moire.tissues.focus('relay', 2.2); moire.relayAt = f; return JSON.stringify({f, c: await moire.signals.now()})
const f = moire.relayAt; moire.signals.drop(f.x - 9 * moire.cells.R, f.y); return 'poked'
